messages: elaine: Quick round of small UX/a11y nits on the Compliance > Storage panel. Dropping them here to avoid scope creep in the release. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/Compliance-Storage pavan: Thanks — list them out and I can pick up the small frontend bits. elaine: 1) Labeling: current row label reads 'Data expiry'. Users in research called this ambiguous. Proposed: 'Retention period' with helper 'how long we keep data'. hiro: +1. For the input label suggest 'Retention period (days)' so auditors see the word 'retention' next to the numeric field. elaine: 2) Toggle behavior: when selecting 'Indefinite' the days input remains editable which confuses people. Design suggestion: collapse into a single pill 'Kept indefinitely' and hide the number. sam: Implementation note — hiding is fine but make sure to set aria-hidden on the numeric input and expose an aria-live announcement 'Retention set to indefinite' so screen reader users get feedback. pavan: Good call. We'll avoid showing a disabled input which reads oddly in some AT. elaine: 3) Region selector: currently sorted by internal code. Product asks we reorder by usage with a 'Recommended' badge for org-preferred region. Also add a short hint under the dropdown: 'Region affects where data is stored and may affect latency'. Make it aria-describedby. hiro: Example to implement: Region affects where data is stored and may affect latency That will make it programmatically tied. sam: Also watch focus: keyboard users should tab from region to retention control. There's a reported focus-skip where the audit link gets focus next. I'll include repro steps in the ticket. elaine: 4) KMS badge string: change from 'Customer key' to 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'. Security also requested an accessible label: aria-label='Encryption key: customer-managed (BYOK)'. hiro: When multiple keys exist add a 'Key details' link that opens a drawer with Key ID, created on, and rotation policy. Drawer should have role=dialog, aria-modal=true, and focus must move to the heading. pavan: For CSV export and UI, policy requires timestamps to be UTC and labeled. We'll standardize to 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm UTC' and CSV header 'timestamp_utc'. policy-bot can confirm. policy-bot: [policy] Confirmed. Audit export format must use UTC with header 'timestamp_utc'. See /policies/retention/export-format. elaine: Small copy nit: change audit search placeholder to 'Filter by user, action, resource or date' — makes the filter affordance clearer. sam: I'll add a11y acceptance criteria: 1) aria-live announcement on toggle, 2) focus order test between region -> retention -> audit filters, 3) drawer focus management. pavan: I'll file a frontend ticket today with the aria-describedby snippet, hiding numeric input, and dropdown ordering change. ETA tomorrow AM. hiro: I'll mock the drawer content and post the artboard. elaine: Thanks — tagging @sam for a11y signoff, @hiro for key copy, @pavan for implementation. :white_check_mark:
